items.title: 150 keer Bosz bij PSV: slechts vier trainers boekten meer zeges
items.summary: Peter Bosz zit zaterdag bij het uitduel met Excelsior voor de 150ste keer als hoofdtrainer op de bank bij PSV. Kijkend naar de hoeveelheid zeges in die reeks officiële wedstrijden moet Bosz een viertal (oud-)collega's voor zich laten.

items.title: Standard heeft een probleem: overbodige speler slikt ferme domper
items.summary: Thomas Henry, vorig seizoen uit de selectie gezet door Vincent Euvrard en later door de clubleiding, hoort ook dit seizoen 2026-2027 nog steeds niet bij de plannen van Standard. Hij ging normaal gezien andere oorden opzoeken, maar is nu niet door de medische testen geraakt.

items.title: Bruges ne veut pas le vendre, Manchester United insiste et prépare une offre colossale

items.title: 'This is the right one' - Rohl on leaving Rangers for Salzburg

items.title: Descendu avec Dender, Luc Marijnissen revient en Jupiler Pro League

items.title: 'KV Mechelen slaat toe en plukt verdediger weg bij Dender'

items.title: VI Live: PSV na valse Eredivisie-start nu tegen de koploper Excelsior
items.summary: PSV hoopt zich zaterdag te revancheren voor de valse Eredivisie-start van vorige week. Na de remise tegen Fortuna Sittard neemt de kampioen van Nederland het zaterdag om 20.00 uur op tegen Excelsior, de koploper na de eerste speelronde. Mis niets van deze wedstrijd in de VI Live.

items.title: Visite médicale ratée pour Thomas Henry !
items.summary: Alors que sa signature au Panetolikós, en Grèce, était attendue ce week-end, Thomas Henry a manqué ses traditionnels tests médicaux. L'attaquant français doit donc se trouver un nouveau point de chute, mais doit toujours bien être libéré de son contrat.

items.title: Véél lekkers: Club, Union, Anderlecht, STVV (en Gent?) weten stilaan aan wat ze zich mogen verwachten
items.summary: KAA Gent en RSC Anderlecht wisten zich allebei opnieuw een ronder verder te worstelen in hun Europees avontuur. En zo komen de Europese League Phases stilaan dichterbij. Ook daarin zou het wel eens bijzonder hard genieten kunnen worden.

items.title: Bischoff treedt met aanvallende intenties in voetsporen van Saibari
items.summary: NEC blijkt met Clement Bischoff een vleugelspeler te hebben gehaald met veel diepgang en dreiging. Dat liet hij vorige week zien in het verloren competitieduel met Telstar . Bischoff noteerde de meeste balcontacten in de vijandelijke zestien van alle spelers die in de eerste speelronde van de Eredivisie in actie kwamen.

items.title: Le Racing Genk a déjà trouvé le remplaçant de Zakaria El Ouahdi
items.summary: Kevin Amaro est le remplaçant de Zakaria El Ouahdi au Racing Genk. Si le Marocain n'est pas encore parti, l'Uruguayen arrive contre plus de trois millions d'euros au sein d'un club limbourgeois qui a anticipé le départ de son participant à la Coupe du monde 2026.

items.title: ‘Not going to be an issue’: Mikel Arteta relaxed about Arsenal contract situation
items.summary: Manager’s deal expires at end of the new season ‘They don’t have to worry … I want to be here’ Mikel Arteta has said he is relaxed about his Arsenal contract expiring at the end of the new season and believes his side will need to be better than last year to defend their title successfully. The Premier League champions will face Enzo Maresca’s Manchester City in the Community Shield in Cardiff on Sunday and are heavy favourites to win back-to-back league titles for the first time since the 1930s. The departure of Pep Guardiola from their traditional rivals City means Arteta is now the Premier League’s longest-serving manager, with the Spaniard having joined in December 2019. items.title: Raúl Jiménez’s injury-time penalty salvages point for Wolves against Blackburn
items.summary: Raúl Jiménez marked his return to Wolves with the stoppage-time equaliser that saved them from an embarrassing start to their return to the Championship. The Mexico striker, who scored against England during the World Cup, came off the bench to convert a penalty given for handball by Ryan Alebiosu that would have had VAR questioning whether the defender was in the area when Jackson Tchatchoua’s cross struck his arm. One minor consolation from Wolves’ relegation is that the video assistant referee is no longer their problem. Jiménez, who had bought scarves for all supporters in the South Bank in gratitude for their welcome home, tucked away his first goal in this second spell for the club he graced during their recent heyday before leaving for Fulham. items.title: Europe’s top clubs threatened Club World Cup boycott before Fifa plan collapsed
items.summary: Ultimatum issued hours before plan was scrapped European Football Clubs demanded Infantino back down Europe’s leading clubs threatened not to participate in future Club World Cups unless Gianni Infantino withdrew his Fifa Forward Enterprise scheme, issuing their ultimatum hours before the plan was scrapped. In a letter to the Fifa secretary general, Mattias Grafström, the influential European Football Clubs (EFC) group warned that its cooperation with future tournaments would hinge on Infantino backing down. It said the threat would hold unless a joint venture between EFC and Fifa – a framework for which has already been agreed – is completed before television rights can be sold for the 2028 Women’s Club World Cup. Continue reading...

items.title: Chelsea expect Enzo Fernández to stay after Manchester City opt not to meet deadline
items.summary: City could maintain interest despite lack of bid Maresca expecting busy end to transfer window Manchester City did not make a £120m bid for Enzo Fernández before Chelsea’s 5pm deadline on Friday but Enzo Maresca still expects a busy end to the transfer window, as the club seek incomings and outgoings. Chelsea, meanwhile, now expect the Argentina midfielder to stay at Stamford Bridge. Maresca takes charge of City for the first time in a major match on Sunday against Arsenal in Cardiff in the Community Shield but is a long way from finalising the squad he will have for the season. Fernández, who played under Maresca at Chelsea, remains a target for City, who could still test the water despite missing the deadline. Continue reading...

items.title: Liverpool owner FSG seals £1.65bn sale of 30% stake to consortium including Jeff Bezos
items.summary: Confirmed deal values club as a whole at £5.5bn Amit Bhatia will become club’s new vice-chairman Liverpool’s owner, Fenway Sports Group, has confirmed it has agreed the sale of 30% of the club to a consortium including Amit Bhatia, the Amazon founder Jeff Bezos and the Facebook co-founder Eduardo Saverin. The deal is understood to be worth £1.65bn, valuing Liverpool at £5.5bn, and will see Bhatia become the club’s new vice-chair on an expanded board. Bhatia, the son-in-law of Indian steel magnate Lakshmi Mittal, initiated and led talks with FSG on behalf of the 1892 Holdings consortium, a reference to Liverpool’s founding year. The former co-owner of Queens Park Rangers has received financial backing from the Mittal Family Trust, the K5 Sports fund, of which Bezos is the lead investor, and EE Capital, the family office of Elaine and Eduardo Saverin.
